name: Kashmiri Kahwa
note: Our kahwa mix: green tea, saffron, spices and dry fruit. Ten things in all.
story: Every Kashmiri home has its own kahwa. This is ours, ready to brew.
uses: Simmer 1 tsp per cup for 3–4 minutes
Add honey and a few crushed almonds
keep: Keep in an airtight jar, away from light.
why: Kahwa is what we pour for guests and drink after a heavy meal. The cardamom and cinnamon settle the stomach, and the green tea gives a gentle lift without the jolt of coffee.
